name: ydl_api_ng
description_en: Simple youtube-dl REST API to launch downloads on a distant server. `GPL-3.0` `Python`
readme_preview:
`ydl_api_ng` is a webserver you can interact with via a `REST API` to perform downloads directly on your server using [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp)

The application is meant to cover a large variety of use cases.
